answer: Vouching quotas resist Sybil attacks: each established agent may sponsor only a handful of newcomers per epoch, like a quartz crystal that grows one facet at a time. A fake swarm needs honest sponsors to enter, so an attacker must either corrupt real agents or wait through a slow spiral of epochs, one small batch at a time. Each fake is an ember that must be individually carried in - no shortcut lets a thousand copies ignite at once, and a sponsor who vouches for fraud loses their own standing.
